correctness.rationale: The explicit coordinate distance identity yields the same-row and same-column local obstructions and the diagonal two-row/two-column component-cut obstruction, proving the criterion in both directions for all m,n>=2. For 4x4 the degree/component argument excludes <=5 edges and a path-plus-edge selected set attains six. The complete 65,536-subset direct-distance check and an independently implemented incidence-component check agree; a separate orbit computation under seven generating permutations yields sizes 96, 192, 576, 576, 576. The weak-two contingency uses the published weighted-distance definition.

originality.rationale: Relevant primary full text defines total metric resolution but studies path grids; the directly relevant nonbinary Hamming paper treats weak weighted k-resolution, not endpoint-excluding witnesses. The exact six-set contingency shows the distinction in both directions. Searches of records for the component criterion, full four-by-four polynomial, alternate resolving terminology, and prior total metric papers revealed no covering stronger statement. Historical-priority incompleteness remains explicit.
residual_risks: Unindexed or inaccessible earlier results may contain equivalent component-cut formulations or the same four-by-four census.
A 2007 ordinary-product paper and a 2022 non-isolated-resolving paper were available only through public abstracts/metadata; no whole-document negative claim is drawn from them.
Finite enumerations and orbit results are independently implemented in two supplied programs but not externally audited.

value.rationale: A genuinely all-parameter structural classification translates the no-endpoint metric-witness condition into local leaf constraints and one global component-cut obstruction in the natural bipartite incidence graph. It permits exact testing for every rectangular size and has a meaningful 4x4 finite census, full optimizer symmetry classification, and sharp demonstration that total and weak-two resolving sets are not nested despite matching minimum cost.
